text:
maria: Drafting the release note for today's staging rollout — need a quick copycheck and a pin for 17:30 UTC. Also need rollback criteria confirmed. @sam @sylvia

maria: Draft RN snippet (very short):
```
Staging rollout: updated inference kernels + quantization profile. Expect ~15% median latency improvement for long-context workloads and lower token cost for embeddings. No customer-facing changes.
Rollout: staged canary (10%) -> ramp to 100% if metrics stable.
Rollback: automatic fallback to model-v1.9-quant on error spike or >3% request failure for 5m.
```

sam: Ack. I'll double-check the rollback thresholds with SRE. Do we want canary traffic split as 10/30/60 or 10 then jump to 100 after health check?

maria: Plan is 10% for 10m health window, then 100% if no regressions. No intermediate 30%. We want quick signal.

deploy-bot: @maria scheduled deploy job db-7243 for 2024-08-21T17:30:00Z — status: pending (will post updates).

sylvia: Quick copy nit: replace "latency improvements" -> "median latency improvement" and add a one-liner about cost-per-token drop. Also confirm embargo: internal only, no external blast today?

evan: I can take the internal announcement. Suggest: short header + two bullets (what changed, how to verify) + oncall contacts. Draft below — feel free to paste into console.

evan: Internal announce draft:
```
Heads up — staging rollout at 17:30 UTC (db-7243)
- What: updated inference kernels + quantization profile; expected ~15% median latency improvement on long-context requests and reduced token cost for embeddings.
- Verify: run `curl https://staging-api.redwood.internal/health` and check p50/p95 on the rollout dashboard.
- Rollback: automatic fallback to model-v1.9-quant if >3% failures for a sustained 5m window, or manual rollback by ops.
If you see anything odd ping @oncall-lisa and thread #incidents.
```

oncall-lisa: Oncall will standby 17:15-18:00 UTC. I'll monitor errors/latency and will hit rollback if 5xx rate spikes >1% sustained over 5m. Assigning myself to db-7243.

maria: Thanks — making the copy edits and pinning the RN now. Pinning note to #eng-releases and will trigger the scheduled deploy. :shipit:

maria: Final RN posted to console: https://redwood.internal/rn/db-7243 (internal). Deploy bot will post progress updates here.

sam: Thx. I'll watch metrics during the canary window and stand ready for rollback if needed.

sylvia: LGTM from comms side. No external comms today.

deploy-bot: db-7243 status update: queued -> started (17:30:12Z). Will report success/failure.

maria: Closing thread — will update if anything comes up.
